description: Verify that TCP in LISTEN sends a RST after receiving a spurious SYN,ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p35)
approach:
[Objective]
A SYN,ACK arriving at LISTEN is unsolicited (DUT didn't send a SYN). RFC 793 §3.4 requires DUT to reply with RST.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST.

[Pass condition]
DUT RST observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT RST

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied RST to spurious LISTEN SYN,ACK — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT RST to LISTEN SYN,ACK
